title: CLOSER: Evidence-Aware Active Visual Verification for Embodied Object-Goal Navigation
title_zh: CLOSER：面向具身目标导航的证据感知主动视觉验证

paragraphs.en: CLOSER提出证据感知的主动视觉验证框架，通过VLM与主动感知结合判断目标候选，显著提升具身目标导航成功率。 Object-goal navigation (ObjectNav) requires an embodied agent to find an instance of a specified category in an unseen environment and stop near it. The agent typically relies on an object detector but must judge online from a limited egocentric video stream, sometimes a single frame, whether a detected candidate is the target. Detectors often confidently mistake similar objects, such as a sofa for a bed, and stopping at a false positive fails the episode. Prevailing systems also approach candidates greedily, leaving them occluded or partially observed. We present CLOSER, an evidence-aware active verification framework that treats stopping as closed-loop evidence acquisition, coupling vision-language model (VLM) verification with active perception. CLOSER fine-tunes an open-source VLM to label each view of a candidate tracked across frames as target, non-target, or uncertain, selects complementary views with an embedding-based diversity gate, and fuses their per-view probabilities with a lightweight network. If the fused judgment remains uncertain, a diffusion policy drives the agent toward the candidate using only the tracked mask and depth until the decision becomes decisive. CLOSER runs locally and plugs into existing ObjectNav systems without retraining them. On Gibson and Habitat-Matterport 3D, it raises average success rate by 3.6 points and success weighted by path length by 2.0 points, showing that verifying evidence before committing improves embodied navigation.
paragraphs.zh: CLOSER提出证据感知的主动视觉验证框架，通过VLM与主动感知结合判断目标候选，显著提升具身目标导航成功率。目标导航（ObjectNav）要求具身智能体在未见过的环境中找到指定类别的一个实例并停在其附近。 智能体通常依赖目标检测器，但必须在线地从有限的第一视角视频流（有时是单帧图像）中判断检测到的候选是否为目标。 检测器常常很自信地混淆相似物体，例如把沙发误认为床，而在误报处停下会导致整个回合失败。 现有系统还会贪婪地接近候选目标，使其处于被遮挡或仅被部分观察的状态。 我们提出CLOSER，一个证据感知的主动验证框架，它将停止决策视为闭环的证据获取过程，将视觉语言模型（VLM）验证与主动感知相结合。 CLOSER对一个开源VLM进行微调，将被跨帧跟踪的候选的每个视角标注为目标、非目标或不确定，通过基于嵌入的多样性门控选择互补视角，并用轻量级网络融合各视角的概率。 如果融合后的判断仍不确定，扩散策略仅利用跟踪掩码和深度信息驱使智能体接近该候选，直到决策变得明确。 CLOSER可本地运行，并能即插即用地接入现有ObjectNav系统而无需对其进行重训练。 在Gibson和Habitat-Matterport 3D数据集上，它将平均成功率提升了3.6个点，将按路径长度加权的成功率提升了2.0个点，表明在做出决策前验证证据能够改进具身导航。
